title: Test-Time Forecasting: Recurrent Depth Enables In-Context Dynamics Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.19552v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Foundation models for dynamical systems can forecast unseen partial differential equations (PDEs), ordinary differential equations (ODEs), and time series during inference. However, it remains an open question whether these foundation models truly learn generalizable in-context forecasting strategies. We show that looped transformers are capable of emulating propagators for dynamical systems in-context by first establishing a link between linear attention and (extended) dynamic mode decomposition. We then generalize this insight into the $\textit{Test-Time Forecasting}$ (TTF) framework in which a one-step forecaster leverages iterations of gradient descent as recurrent depth. We demonstrate that lightweight TTF models trained on ODEs and PDEs generalize to out-of-distribution system dynamics during autoregressive rollout after being trained for one-step prediction. translated_title: 测试时预测：循环深度实现上下文动力学预测
translated_abstract: 面向动力系统的基础模型能够在推理阶段对未见过的偏微分方程（PDE）、常微分方程（ODE）以及时间序列进行预测。然而，这些基础模型是否真正学到了可泛化的上下文预测策略，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。我们首先建立了线性注意力与（扩展）动态模态分解之间的联系，据此证明循环 transformer 能够在上下文中模拟动力系统的传播子。随后，我们将这一洞见推广为“测试时预测”（Test-Time Forecasting, TTF）框架，其中单步预测器利用梯度下降的迭代过程作为循环深度。我们证明，仅在 ODE 和 PDE 上进行单步预测训练的轻量级 TTF 模型，在自回归展开时能够泛化到分布外的系统动力学。我们的结果进一步证实了 TTF 是一个具有理论依据的框架，可用于设计……（原文此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过建立线性注意力与动态模态分解的联系，提出测试时预测（TTF）框架，以梯度下降迭代作为循环深度，使仅经过单步预测训练的轻量级模型在自回归展开中即可泛化到分布外的动力系统动力学。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Test-Time Forecasting (TTF) framework by linking linear attention to (extended) dynamic mode decomposition, using gradient descent iterations as recurrent depth, which enables lightweight models trained only for one-step prediction to generalize to out-of-distribution dynamical systems during autoregressive rollout.
